text:
matt-infra: Heads-up: seeing NATGW ephemeral port attrition in us-central-3. Model-pull spikes from edge proxies causing ALBs to 502/504 and some sidecars OOM. Anyone else?

anya-eng: Yup, same. Spikes line up with nightly model snapshot pulls at 02:15 UTC. Roughly 1.2k new TCP flows/sec per AZ for ~90s.

lee-sre: Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/d/egress-nat -> NAT ephemeral exhaustion spikes to 100% usage, conn resets rise. TIME_WAIT buildup too. :grimacing: 

infra-bot: alert: NATGW ephemeral_port_utilization > 0.9 us-central-3a (metric window 1m)

mike-net: grabbed tcpdump from proxy sidecar -> many SYNs, then RST/ICMP for ephemeral exhaustion. netstat snippet:
```
$ ss -s
TCP: 120000 estab, 90000 timewait, 42000 closed
``` 

sara-platform: Sidecar v0.12 behavior: we disabled keepalive to avoid long-lived stuck conns earlier. That was for a different issue. Looks like now we get port churn. Recommend enabling keepalive + connection pool (max 100) to reuse src ports.

matt-infra: Can we patch quickly? If sidecars reuse connections we'll reduce new source port creation dramatically. Also consider throttling parallel model pulls from registry.

anya-eng: We can stagger snapshot pulls (delay per node by 200ms jitter) — that would shave peak outflow by ~30%. I'll draft change.

lee-sre: Also: ALB idle timeout is 10s. If we increase to 60s and enable keepalive we further cut churn. But be careful with memory on sidecars.

mike-net: We could tweak kernel: reduce TIME_WAIT duration (tcp_tw_reuse) or increase ephemeral port range but that's cluster-wide and risky. Prefer app-level reuse. Example sysctl we'd avoid unless last resort:
```
net.ipv4.tcp_tw_reuse = 1
net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range = 1024 65535
```

sara-platform: I'll open PR for sidecar keepalive + connection pool + k8s annotation to limit rolling restarts. Canary plan: deploy to 5 pods in us-central-3a, monitor natgw_ephemeral_util, tcp_timewait, 1h canary.

matt-infra: Lee, can you open a cloud support ticket to request NATGW scale guidance / soft limit increase? vendor might have suggestions for per-AZ throughput.

lee-sre: On it. Ticket #INC-2489. Also enabling zonal NLB for model registry egress could help route across AZs more smoothly.

anya-eng: I'll add throttling patch to snapshot job (200ms jitter + max_concurrency 8) and push to canary as config.

sara-platform: PR link: https://github.com/redwood/sidecar/pull/432 — contains keepalive, pool=100, k8s annotation `sidecar.connPool: enabled`

matt-infra: Great. Action owners: sara (PR/deploy), anya (model-pull throttling), lee (cloud ticket), mike (conntrack/sysctl runbook). Recheck in 30m. :thumbsup:

sara-platform: Canary up on us-central-3a -> initial telemetry looks promising: ephemeral_util down 45% in 5m window. I'll post updates.
